role: XCTest suite for LivePaceEstimator fed by a harness that re-creates WorkoutLocationManager's chunked GPS distance credit: steady walker/runner pace across fix rates and accuracies, pedometer fallback when GPS is poor, Doppler speed use/rejection, pace clearing after stopping, foot-pod precedence, reset, and steady walking METs.
types: PaceRun: struct — straight-line motion with GPS fixes, optional pedometer/Doppler/stop, 1 Hz ticker
GPSCredit: struct — re-implementation of WorkoutLocationManager.creditMovement's 3.5 m / 1.5×accuracy (≤20 m) step rule
toplevel: Private helper structs PaceRun and GPSCredit.

flags.text: GPSCredit hand-copies WorkoutLocationManager's credit rule (max(3.5, min(1.5×accuracy, 20))) instead of calling it; the production rule uses both fixes' accuracies via noiseFloor (WorkoutLocationManager.swift:374,402), so a production change does not reach these tests.
